note: Envelope accept/reject cases for both envelope specs. `text` is the envelope's JSON text exactly as on the wire; `kid`/`seed_hex` (and `onetime_seed_hex` for 0.2.0) say who opens it. accept: MUST pass the shape check and open to plaintext_utf8. reject with stage "shape": MUST be refused by the shape check alone, before any key is used. reject with stage "crypto": MUST pass the shape check and MUST fail to open. See docs/ENVELOPE-DRAFT.md (Wire shape).

accept.name: golden-compact
accept.why: the golden 0.1.0 envelope as compact JSON

accept.name: members-reordered-and-indented
accept.why: member order and whitespace are not part of the shape

accept.name: fs-golden-compact
accept.why: the golden 0.2.0 envelope as compact JSON

reject.name: extra-member
reject.why: an unknown top-level member; the tags do not cover it

reject.name: extra-recipient-member
reject.why: an unknown member on a recipient entry

reject.name: payload-uppercase-hex
reject.why: hex must be lowercase: one wire form per envelope

reject.name: kem-ct-uppercase-hex
reject.why: hex must be lowercase

reject.name: wrapped-cek-uppercase-hex
reject.why: hex must be lowercase

reject.name: duplicate-member-payload
reject.why: a repeated member name: a last-wins reader opens the second payload and never reads the first

reject.name: duplicate-member-recipient-kid
reject.why: a repeated member name inside a recipient entry

reject.name: byte-order-mark
reject.why: a UTF-8 byte-order mark before the envelope

reject.name: trailing-content
reject.why: a second JSON value after the envelope

reject.name: content-key-16-bytes
reject.why: a 16-byte content key (AES-128-GCM under the AES-256-GCM label); the wrapped key is not 48 bytes

reject.name: content-key-24-bytes
reject.why: a 24-byte content key (AES-192-GCM under the AES-256-GCM label)

reject.name: same-recipient-twice
reject.why: the same kid in two recipient entries (the AAD binds [kid, kid], so it opens unless refused)

reject.name: missing-enc-alg
reject.why: a required member is absent

reject.name: alg-of-the-other-spec
reject.why: enc_alg must be the one that belongs to spec

reject.name: unknown-spec
reject.why: an envelope version this specification does not define

reject.name: payload-nonce-13-bytes
reject.why: nonces are exactly 12 bytes

reject.name: wrap-nonce-11-bytes
reject.why: nonces are exactly 12 bytes

reject.name: kem-ct-one-byte-short
reject.why: an ML-KEM-1024 ciphertext is exactly 1568 bytes

reject.name: payload-shorter-than-a-tag
reject.why: the payload carries at least its 16-byte tag

reject.name: payload-odd-length-hex
reject.why: hex is whole bytes

reject.name: payload-nonce-null
reject.why: null is not a string

reject.name: kid-not-hex
reject.why: kid is 8 bytes of lowercase hex

reject.name: recipients-empty
reject.why: at least one recipient

reject.name: recipients-seventeen
reject.why: at most 16 recipients

reject.name: recipient-as-array
reject.why: a recipient entry written positionally, as an array

reject.name: envelope-as-array
reject.why: the envelope itself written as an array

reject.name: fs-prekey-id-with-nul
reject.why: prekey_id is 1-64 of [A-Za-z0-9._-]; it is concatenated into the key-derivation label

reject.name: fs-prekey-id-too-long
reject.why: prekey_id is at most 64 characters

reject.name: fs-recipient-without-prekey-id
reject.why: a 0.2.0 recipient must name its one-time prekey

reject.name: static-recipient-in-fs-envelope
reject.why: 0.1.0 recipient members under a 0.2.0 spec

reject.name: fs-kem-ct-onetime-one-byte-short
reject.why: the ciphertext to the one-time prekey is exactly 1568 bytes

reject.name: fs-kem-ct-onetime-uppercase-hex
reject.why: hex must be lowercase, in every member

reject.name: fs-kem-ct-static-one-byte-short
reject.why: the ciphertext to the static key is exactly 1568 bytes

reject.name: fs-kem-ct-static-uppercase-hex
reject.why: hex must be lowercase, in every member

reject.name: payload-bit-flipped
reject.why: one payload bit changed

reject.name: payload-nonce-altered
reject.why: a different payload nonce

reject.name: wrapped-cek-bit-flipped
reject.why: one bit of the wrapped content key changed

reject.name: kem-ct-bit-flipped
reject.why: one bit of the ML-KEM ciphertext changed (implicit rejection, then the wrap tag fails)

reject.name: two-recipients-reordered
reject.why: the payload AAD binds the ORDERED recipient set

reject.name: two-recipients-one-dropped
reject.why: the payload AAD binds the WHOLE recipient set

reject.name: two-recipients-one-dropped-other-side
reject.why: the remaining recipient cannot open either

reject.name: two-recipients-keys-swapped
reject.why: each wrapped key is bound to its own kid

reject.name: recipient-relabelled
reject.why: an entry sealed for one kid, relabelled with another's kid

reject.name: fs-prekey-id-relabelled
reject.why: prekey_id is bound into the key derivation and the payload AAD

reject.name: fs-onetime-ct-bit-flipped
reject.why: one bit of the one-time ciphertext changed

reject.name: fs-static-ct-bit-flipped
reject.why: one bit of the static ciphertext changed

reject.name: fs-payload-bit-flipped
reject.why: one payload bit changed
